page.notes: The right side of the page is cropped by the scan, so the ends of many lines are lost and marked illegible. Hebrew vowel points are hard to read at this resolution; the consonants are copied as seen, and doubtful forms carry [?]. The entry heading in the second row and the Hebrew phrases in the gloss lines are the least certain. The page number 791 and running head שׁ are printed at the top. The catchword is not visible. The signature Ddd d and a cross mark appear at the foot, the cross being a printer's or digitiser's mark and not transcribed.
